from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company, as stated in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Period of the report, e.g., 'quarter ended March 31, 2025'")
    net_income: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income/loss amount for the quarter")
    cash_and_equivalents: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents at period end")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets at period end")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of net income, e.g., 'million', 'thousands'")
    cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of cash, e.g., 'million', 'thousands'")
    assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of assets, e.g., 'million', 'thousands'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
